references.text: The sin offering with one male goat is prescribed as a fixed part of the sacrificial service, just as it is described here for the seventh day of the Feast of Tabernacles.
The same wording regarding one male goat as a sin offering is used repeatedly throughout chapter 29 for the festival offerings.
Identical wording concerning the sin offering with one male goat in addition to the daily burnt offering, along with its accompanying grain offering and drink offering.
The same structure with a sin offering in addition to the daily burnt offering, which is repeated for each day of the Feast of Tabernacles.
A parallel text describing the sin offering and the daily burnt offering for another day of the Feast of Tabernacles.
The same pattern with a sin offering and the daily burnt offering is repeated for the third day of the festival.
An identical concluding formula for the offerings on the fourth day of the Feast of Tabernacles.
The same conclusion with a sin offering and the daily burnt offering for the fifth day.
A parallel formulation for the sixth day of the Feast of Tabernacles.
The description of the daily burnt offering (עֹלַת הַתָּמִיד) with its grain offering and drink offering as referred to in the verse.
Basic instructions for the daily burnt offering that was to be offered morning and evening.
